# `github.com/grow-codes-packages/zipkin/go` — agent quickstart (Go)

Ships in the module root (`go env GOMODCACHE`/github.com/grow-codes-packages/zipkin/go@vX/AGENTS.md). Use it
instead of reading the source. Docs: https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/zipkin/ · Service: Zipkin ·
Categories: tracing. Package name: `zipkin`. Needs Go >= 1.26 (`GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` on older images).

```sh
go get github.com/grow-codes-packages/zipkin/go@latest
```

## Client

```go
import zipkin "github.com/grow-codes-packages/zipkin/go"

client, err := zipkin.NewClientFromEnv() // GROW_ZIPKIN_* > vendor env > defaults
defer client.Close()
```

Errors are `*zipkin.Error` with `Code`; use `errors.Is(err, zipkin.ErrNotFound)` (`ErrConfig`, `ErrAuthentication`,
`ErrPermissionDenied`, `ErrConflict`, `ErrRateLimited`, `ErrValidation`, `ErrUnavailable`, `ErrTimeout`,
`ErrUnsupported`, `ErrCancelled`). Credentials are `Secret` (redacted in fmt/slog/JSON).

## Tracing

The tracing entry point (`initTracing` / `InitTracing` / `init_tracing`) and its options are documented in the
package README and https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/zipkin/tracing/ (span helpers `withSpan`, `traced`,
`currentTraceId`, HTTP middleware).

Package `github.com/grow-codes-packages/zipkin/go/testkit`: in-memory fakes.
